sources.title: DMEGC launches steel-framed solar module series
sources.excerpt:
The new series of n-type bifacial solar modules features a steel frame with an S-shaped cross-section. The modules deliver 640 W to 665 W of power output and offer a bifaciality factor of up to 85%, with the new frame design reportedly reducing rear-side shading by 76%.
